2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/rate-limiter'

4	describe('RateLimiter', () => {
5	  it('allows the first request', () => {
6	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
7	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
8	  })
9	
10	  it('blocks the request after max is reached in fixed mode', () => {
11	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 3, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
12	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
13	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
14	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
15	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
16	  })
17	
18	  it('tracks independent keys separately', () => {
19	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
20	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
21	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
22	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
23	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
24	  })
25	
26	  it('resets capacity at the start of the next fixed window', () => {
27	    let now = 0
28	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({
29	      max: 2,
30	      windowMs: 1000,
31	      mode: 'fixed',
32	      now: () => now,
33	    })
34	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
35	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
36	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
37	    now = 1000
38	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
39	  })
40

42	    let now = 0

52	  })
53

65	  })
